chunks: And ʿAmr ibn Shimr narrated from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about advance payment for meat. He said: “Do not approach it, for at one time he may give you fat meat, at another time lean meat, and at another time emaciated meat. So buy it by direct inspection, hand to hand.”

He said: And I asked him about advance payment for water-skins. So he said: “No, for at one time he may give you an incomplete one and at another time a complete one. Rather, buy them by direct inspection, for this is safer for you and for him.”

key_terms.السَّلَفِ: advance payment sale for future delivery
key_terms.اللَّحْمِ: meat as a sale item with variable quality
key_terms.رَوَايَا الْمَاءِ: water-skins or water containers being sold
key_terms.مُعَايَنَةً: with direct inspection and visual examination

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pay in advance for meat or water-skins when their quality may vary?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling discouraging salam-type advance sale in goods whose qualities vary significantly, such as meat and water-skins. The Imam عليه السلام directs the buyer instead to a direct, hand-to-hand sale with inspection, so that ambiguity and dispute are avoided for both parties.
